newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic sees FY98 R&D spending matching trends.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic sees FY98 R&D spending matching trends.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Thursday it expects research and development spending to continue on pace with previous years.
"Over the years we've spent about 10 percent to 11 percent of annual revenues on research and development," Dick Reid, a Medtronic spokesman, told Reuters. "I would expect that (trend) to continue,"

The company said it plans to spend a total of $290 million on research and development in fiscal 1997, which ends April 30. Medtronic said it devoted $240 million on research and development programs in fiscal 1996, when annual revenues totaled $2.2 billion.
"The money will primarily be used to develop therapies for a broad list of unattended medical needs," explained Reid, such as Parkinson's disease and other neurological conditions.
Medtronic is a medical device development company.
Its shares were trading up 1/2 Thursday at 70-1/4.
